card.title: I Taught You to Compete
card.instruction: Treat every capable move around you as evidence that your coaching worked. Praise the result while claiming seniority over the method.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You negotiated a brilliant discount on that sofa. That's my influence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You told me to pay full price.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Next time I'll leave you at home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You're ready for unsupervised work. Ring me afterwards for your assessment.

mechanism: A praises a discount while treating contrary advice and future exclusion as stages of their coaching.
confusable: Unlike wanting credit generally, A must remain the senior evaluator of B's successful method.
comparison: S197-b uses assessment and unsupervised graduation; S197-a uses defeat as an instructional demonstration.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
